name: Canonical Title & Closing Engine — Title Order, Risk, Clearance, Settlement & Closing Finalization

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const eventType=String(b.eventType??b.type??'executed_contract').trim().toLowerCase(); const leadId=String(b.leadId??'').trim(); const propertyId=String(b.propertyId??'').trim(); const dealId=String(b.dealId??'').trim(); const contractId=String(b.contractId??'').trim(); const assignmentId=String(b.assignmentId??'').trim(); const titleOrderId=String(b.titleOrderId??'').trim(); const settlementId=String(b.settlementId??'').trim(); const portfolioId=String(b.portfolioId??'').trim(); const idempotencyKey=String(b.idempotencyKey??('title-closing:'+eventType+':'+leadId+':'+dealId+':'+assignmentId+':'+(b.eventId??titleOrderId??settlementId))).trim(); return [{json:{...b,eventType,leadId,propertyId,dealId,contractId,assignmentId,titleOrderId,settlementId,portfolioId,idempotencyKey,receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const input=$('Normalize Title Closing Event').first().json; const c=$json.context??$json; const n=x=>Number.isFinite(Number(x))?Number(x):0; const event=String(input.eventType).toLowerCase(); const dealStatus=String(c.dealStatus??'').toLowerCase(); const contractExecuted=c.contractExecuted===true||String(c.contractStatus??'').toLowerCase()==='executed'; const titleStarted=c.titleSearchStarted===true||c.titleOrderId!=null; const titleClear=c.titleCleared===true||String(c.titleStatus??'').toLowerCase()==='cleared'; const liens=n(c.openLiens??c.lienCount); const judgments=n(c.openJudgments??c.judgmentCount); const taxIssues=n(c.taxIssues??c.taxLienCount); const titleExposure=n(c.titleExposure??0); const settlementReady=c.settlementStatementReady===true; const settlementReconciled=c.settlementReconciled===true; const closingCompleted=c.closingCompleted===true; const fundsConfirmed=c.fundsConfirmed===true; const buyerFundsConfirmed=c.buyerFundsConfirmed===true; const sellerPayoffConfirmed=c.sellerPayoffConfirmed===true; const purchasePrice=n(c.purchasePrice); const assignmentFee=n(c.assignmentFee); const totalFunds=n(c.totalFunds); const expectedFunds=purchasePrice+Math.max(0,assignmentFee); const tolerance=0.01; const fundsBalanced=Math.abs(totalFunds-expectedFunds)<=tolerance||c.fundsBalanced===true; const flags=[]; let decision='review'; let action='human_review'; if(['cancelled','disputed'].includes(dealStatus)){decision='blocked';action='hold_closing';flags.push('protected_deal_state');} else if(!contractExecuted){decision='contract_not_executed';action='return_to_contract_engine';flags.push('executed_contract_missing');} else if(event==='title_order'||event==='executed_contract'){decision=titleStarted?'title_in_progress':'initiate_title_order';action=titleStarted?'await_title_results':'start_title_search_and_closing_order';} else if(['title_result','title_search_completed'].includes(event)){ if(liens+judgments+taxIssues>0||titleExposure>0){const severity=titleExposure>10000||liens+judgments+taxIssues>=3?'critical':liens+judgments+taxIssues>=1?'high':'medium'; decision=severity==='critical'?'title_hold_critical':'title_resolution_required';action=severity==='critical'?'halt_and_escalate_title':'resolve_liens_tax_or_encumbrances';flags.push('title_risk_detected');} else {decision='title_cleared';action='prepare_closing_date_and_settlement';}} else if(event==='title_clearance'||titleClear){ if(!settlementReady){decision='settlement_pending';action='complete_settlement_statement';flags.push('settlement_not_ready');} else if(!settlementReconciled){decision='settlement_reconciliation_required';action='reconcile_assignment_fee_costs_and_funds';flags.push('settlement_not_reconciled');} else {decision='closing_ready';action='coordinate_buyer_seller_title_company_closing';}} else if(['settlement','settlement_event'].includes(event)){ if(!settlementReady){decision='settlement_pending';action='complete_settlement_statement';} else if(!settlementReconciled){decision='settlement_reconciliation_required';action='reconcile_settlement';} else {decision='closing_ready';action='coordinate_closing';}} else if(['closing_completed','funds_confirmed','close'].includes(event)){ if(!titleClear||!settlementReconciled||!closingCompleted||!fundsConfirmed||!buyerFundsConfirmed||!sellerPayoffConfirmed||!fundsBalanced){decision='closing_completion_pending';action='collect_missing_closing_evidence'; if(!titleClear)flags.push('title_not_cleared'); if(!settlementReconciled)flags.push('settlement_not_reconciled'); if(!closingCompleted)flags.push('closing_completion_missing'); if(!fundsConfirmed||!buyerFundsConfirmed||!sellerPayoffConfirmed||!fundsBalanced)flags.push('funds_evidence_incomplete');} else {decision='closed';action='finalize_deal_and_trigger_financial_reconciliation';}} else if(event==='rescheduled'){decision='closing_rescheduled';action='update_closing_date_and_notify_parties';} else if(event==='cancelled'){decision='closing_cancelled';action='hold_and_recovery_review';} else {decision=titleClear&&settlementReconciled?'closing_ready':'closing_review';action=titleClear?'complete_settlement_and_closing_requirements':'review_title_and_closing_requirements';} const titleRiskScore=Math.min(100,(liens+judgments+taxIssues)*20+(titleExposure>0?20:0)); const readinessScore=Math.round((contractExecuted?15:0)+(titleClear?20:0)+(settlementReady?15:0)+(settlementReconciled?15:0)+(closingCompleted?10:0)+(fundsConfirmed?10:0)+(buyerFundsConfirmed?5:0)+(sellerPayoffConfirmed?5:0)+(fundsBalanced?5:0)); return [{json:{...input,canonicalTitleClosing:{decision,action,titleRiskScore,titleExposure,liens,judgments,taxIssues,contractExecuted,titleStarted,titleCleared:titleClear,settlementReady,settlementReconciled,closingCompleted,fundsConfirmed,buyerFundsConfirmed,sellerPayoffConfirmed,totalFunds,expectedFunds,fundsBalanced,tolerance,readinessScore,flags,nextEvent:decision==='closed'?'financial_reconciliation':decision==='title_cleared'?'closing_coordination':'none',requiresHumanReview:decision.includes('critical')||decision==='title_resolution_required'||decision==='closing_completion_pending',confidenceScore:Math.min(95,40+readinessScore)},idempotencyKey}}];
